Actual keyboard and touch events and simulated standard PS-style Gamepad API complete both selected siblings, all three entrance cooperation routes, puzzle stages, gifts, badges, key and original ending. They do not claim a full public playthrough. Physical PS controllers and vibration motors were not tested.
